Domain.label: Wonder
Domain.description: The Wonder domain embodies the spark of imagination, the excitement of discovery, and the power of creativity. Those who draw from Wonder see the world as it could be: brighter, different, interesting and beautiful.

autoAstral.name: Spend Astral tokens automatically
autoAstral.hint: Each action roll made in Constellation form spends an Astral token (with an undo button in chat).

autoExplosion.name: Tick the Explosion die automatically
autoExplosion.hint: Reduce the Exploding Enchantment countdown die whenever an action roll is posted to chat.

sheetButton.name: Wonder button on character sheets
sheetButton.hint: Adds a ✦ Wonder button to the header of characters with a Wonder class or cards.

Notify.NoActor: Select a token or assign a character first.
Notify.NeedGM: A GM must be connected to change documents you do not own.
Notify.WonderTouchedSwap: Wonder-Touched: mark {n} Stress instead of the missing Hope?
Notify.NotYours: Only the owner of that character can use this.

Stars.Title: Star Chart
Stars.ClickHint: Click a glowing star connected to your Constellation to mark it · Right-click a marked star to unmark it.
Stars.EmbodyCost: Mark 1 Stress · start with {n} Astral tokens
Stars.AbilitiesHint: Use them from the ✦ Constellation feature on your sheet — they spend Astral tokens.
Stars.CosmicHelp: next Empyrean Call costs 1 less Hope
Stars.WouldDisconnect: That star holds other stars to your Constellation. Unmark the outer stars first.
Stars.NotConnected: You can only mark a star connected to one you already have.
Stars.NoBudget: You can mark {n} stars right now (level + blessings). Ask the GM for extra stars.
Stars.FormEffectHint: Bonuses from your Star Chart while you embody your Constellation.
Stars.AstralHint: Action rolls in this form spend an Astral token. You leave the form with no tokens left or when you mark your last Hit Point.
Stars.EnterBody: Marked 1 Stress and embodied the Constellation with {n} Astral tokens.
Stars.OutOfTokens: No Astral tokens left — the Constellation fades.
Stars.LastHitPoint: Marked the last Hit Point — dropped out of Constellation form.
Stars.NeedForm: You must be in Constellation form.
Stars.EmpyreanBody: Spent {cost} Hope and rolled {roll}: Astral tokens {before} → {after} (max 6).
Stars.TokenSpent: Action roll in Constellation form — {n} Astral tokens left.
Stars.AgainstOdds: Failure with Hope — the Astral token returns.
Stars.BinaryHint: Choose an ally within Far range to be your Binary Star.
Stars.BinaryFree: Standard attack within range of your Binary Star — no Astral token spent.

Ench.Title: Enchanting Workshop
Ench.OtherObjectHint: Anything not on a sheet (target a token if someone holds it)
Ench.BearerHint: Target a token if a creature holds or wears it.
Ench.Adversary: Held or worn by an adversary (Spellcast Roll)
Ench.PickCard: Pick an enchantment card to begin.
Ench.PaidSurge: Ingenious Surge: spent 3 Hope (does not count towards the limit).
Ench.RollSpellcast: Make a Spellcast Roll against the adversary.
Ench.BoomBody: {object} explodes: creatures within Close range make a Reaction Roll (13). Failure: {total} magic damage; success: {half}. The object is destroyed.
Ench.FearlessYes: Rolled a 6 — the GM does not gain a Fear from this roll.
Ench.FearlessNo: No 6 — the GM gains Fear as usual.
Ench.AppraiseHint: Target a token to appraise its items.

Reason.NeedsFeature: The item must have a feature.
Reason.HasFeature: The item already has a feature.
Reason.CombineTwo: Choose two different enchantments to combine.

Note.FeaturesIgnored: The item's features are ignored while enchanted.
Note.Searing: {name} marks a Stress from the heat.
Note.TooBig: {name} becomes too big to be held and is dropped (unequipped).
Note.TooSmall: {name} becomes too small to be used as a weapon (unequipped).
Note.Grown: Two-handed, +{n} damage, features replaced by Powerful.
Note.Shrunk: One-handed, features replaced by Unreliable (−2 attack and damage).
Note.MagicWeapons: Magic Weapons: this weapon attacks with your Spellcast trait.
Note.CreativeFlow: Creative Flow: Spellweave is ready again.

Tinker.Title: Tinkering Bench
Tinker.Intro: Spend handfuls of gold up to your Tier and roll a d8 for each. Pick loot numbered at or below the total — it is a temporary copy until your next long rest.
Tinker.Nothing: No loot at or below this number.
Tinker.CopyNote: Temporary copy (Creative Tinkering) — lasts until your next long rest or until used. Reaction Roll (10) identifies it as a copy.

Glimpse.Intro: When a target makes an action roll, spend a Glimpse die to raise or lower the final result by its value.
Glimpse.Empty: Roll {count}{faces} at the beginning of the session.
Glimpse.Raised: The stars favor {target}: +{n} to the final result.
Glimpse.Lowered: The stars turn against {target}: −{n} to the final result.
Glimpse.NoTarget: No target — the chat message will refer to the last roll.
Glimpse.NoFeature: This character doesn't have Glimpse Beyond.

Moon.Title: Moon Shield
Moon.Prompt: Spend how many Lunar tokens? (you have {n})
Moon.NoTokens: No Lunar tokens on Moon Shield.
Moon.Reduced: Spent {n} Lunar token(s): reduce the damage by {total}.

Masterpiece.Progress: Rolled {roll}: the Masterpiece is worth {value} handfuls (a chest = 100). Gained a Hope.
Masterpiece.ChooseTrait: Choose a trait to gain +1 (the card goes to your vault permanently).

Auto.NextRollHint: Applies to the next action roll, then ends.
Auto.DreamClarity: {name} rolled with Hope: clarity — cleared a Stress.
Auto.DreamDisturbing: {name} rolled with Fear: a disturbing vision — the GM gains 1 Fear.
Auto.WonderTouchedSwapped: Wonder-Touched: {n} Stress marked instead of missing Hope.
Auto.TwinnedHint: {a} and {b} share access to level 3 or lower cards from either loadout (Spellcast Rolls use the caster's trait). Tag Team Rolls between them cost 2 Hope. Once, on a critical success, both gain a Hope and clear a Stress.
Auto.TwinnedBody: {a} and {b} each marked a Stress and synchronized their thoughts until the end of the scene.
Auto.CosmicBody: {name} may reroll using a d20 as their Hope Die.
Auto.SharedDreamHint: When you Help an Ally you shared a dream with ({names}), roll two advantage dice and take the highest.
Auto.ArchiveBody: The card goes to the vault: you and all allies within Far range may recall a card from their vault without paying its Recall Cost. It can only return to your loadout during a rest.
Auto.BreakthroughBody: Success! Each ally within Far range may add a card of level 4 or lower (marking Stress equal to its Recall Cost) until the end of the scene. Breakthrough moved to your vault.
Auto.DeviceUsed: {name} uses the device: +2 on the next roll. The device is depleted.
Auto.GemologyBody: {names} may take an additional downtime move during this rest.
Auto.FidgetyHope: Hope die {n}: the bolt leaps to a second creature of your choice within Close range.
Auto.FidgetyFear: Fear die {n}: the GM chooses another creature within Close range to be hit.
Auto.FidgetyHalf: Leap damage roll {total} → each additional target takes {half} magic damage.
Auto.BinaryHint: +1 Evasion while within {range} range of {name} in Constellation form.
Auto.GravityOffer: Your Binary Star {name} marked {n} Hit Point(s). Spend 2 Astral tokens to pull them to you and reduce it by 1?
Auto.DeviceCrafted: A new device is crafted (charged). Any previous device disappears.
Auto.TokensOnCard: Placed {n} token(s) on the card ({total} now).
Auto.GravityDone: Pulled {name} into Melee range: one Hit Point cleared.
